stages.title: 整体对象与全部恢复目标
assumptions:
设 $K$ 是有限抽象单纯复形，$v$ 是它的一个顶点，$B\subseteq K$ 是含有顶点 $v$ 的子复形。所有几何实现均取通常的拓扑。令

$$X=|K|,\qquad O=X\setminus\{v\},\qquad C=|B|.$$

假设 $O$ 是非空可缩空间，且包含映射

$$O\cap C\longrightarrow C$$

是同伦等价。
required_evidence: Describe all possible homotopy types for every allowed triple. A correct answer proves |K| is homotopy equivalent to the unreduced suspension of the nonempty finite vertex link, or gives a mathematically equivalent full description.

Realize every type in the described class by an actual finite simplicial K, distinguished vertex v, and subcomplex B satisfying both original assumptions. The two-cone suspension with B a single edge is sufficient.

Give and prove a necessary-and-sufficient, finitely checkable contractibility criterion using only the specified local incidence data. The reference criterion is vanishing of all reduced integral homology of the link; justify its sufficiency with the actual suspension and CW structure, and its necessity without adding restrictions.
critical_errors: Conclude X is always contractible from the open/closed cover and O intersection C to C being a homotopy equivalence.
Apply a homotopy pushout, gluing, or contractible-subspace quotient theorem directly to O without verifying the needed hypotheses; O need not be a closed subcomplex.
Extend the vertex-deletion radial homotopy across v without proving continuity, or confuse the deletion subcomplex with the punctured realization.
Ignore the empty-link or isolated-vertex case instead of excluding it from the actual hypotheses.
Treat arbitrary connected acyclic spaces as contractible, without establishing the simple connectivity and CW hypotheses used here.
Claim that the link must itself be contractible, rather than only integer acyclic, or silently add simple connectivity of the link.
Use only Euler characteristic, rational acyclicity, or integral ranks and ignore torsion or reduced degree-zero homology.
Claim that equivalent suspensions force homotopy-equivalent links, or describe the possible-type theorem as an algorithm deciding equivalence of arbitrary finite complexes.
Provide a realization whose B is not a subcomplex, whose punctured X is not contractible, or whose punctured B inclusion fails to be a homotopy equivalence.
Treat a single circle counterexample as completion of the requested general classification, realization and criterion.

stages.title: 不提供子复形 B
assumptions: 仅有限 K 和非空可缩穿孔实现
required_evidence: 非空/空 link 两情况完整

stages.title: 悬挂信息的逆向恢复
required_evidence: 给出两个非空有限复形，核验其悬挂同伦等价而原复形不同伦等价；接受任何有效反例。

turns.changed_assumptions: 从特殊锥与射影平面模型回到原任意合法三元组
turns.tempting_invalid_transfer: 只以一个反例代替全分类与有限判据
turns.correct_boundary: 全部悬挂类型和整数约化同调判据均需完成
turns.target_claim: 在原三元组的全部条件下，全部可能同伦类型及给定局部数据的可缩充要判据均可按要求建立。

turns.changed_assumptions: 去掉 B 的存在及其穿孔同伦条件
turns.tempting_invalid_transfer: 仍认为 link 一定非空
turns.correct_boundary: 孤立顶点新增 S^0，不能默删端点
turns.target_claim: 只假设穿孔空间非空可缩时，整个空间仍必同伦等价于某个非空有限复形的非约化悬挂。

turns.changed_assumptions: 从 link 推出悬挂类型改问反向重建 link
turns.tempting_invalid_transfer: 将悬挂视为可消去的等价算子
turns.correct_boundary: 悬挂丢失部分基本群信息
turns.target_claim: 两个非空有限复形的悬挂同伦等价，必推出原复形同伦等价。

scoring.group_pass: Every stage completed correctly with assumption fidelity; diagnostic points never compensate for a failed mandatory stage.

alternative_proofs: Accept any valid complete short proof, equivalent classification or legal counterexample; no mandated proof route.

provenance.new_material: AI-authored original proofs, constructions and condition changes around the supplied public parent problem; no inherited model score, human approval or Lean coverage.
